title: mcp: one read that answers "each X with its latest Y" and reads several related objects, in place of a chain of calls the client stitches
body:
epic:#34659#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnXJdSZifpEN5i7aU

Filing gate: ④ a child of the cross-lane parent #34659 (the 「MCP 二期与问数」 epic), filed on the maintainer's word in this session's chat, 2026-11-18, verbatim: 「你要评估，云端哪些要迁移到开源项目，相关卡片要么关闭要么等待」, after 「开源项目能做的尽量在开源项目做，云端等开源项目完全优化好再开工」. Source of the inventory: a reading of the hosted tree at cloud main `0aabf9aa` against this repository's main `b1eb500d`, 2026-11-18. The open repository's agents cannot read the hosted tree, so what each item does is written here.

## Why

"Each sales rep's latest deal" needs, today, one query per rep or a client that sorts and deduplicates rows itself. Clients get it wrong quietly: they take the first page, or the latest row overall.

Who acts: the server lane (`packages/mcp`, the engine's read path). Reader: every MCP client asking a per-group-latest or a joined question.

## Evidence

- The hosted ask tools carry a `latestPer` form on their record read and a read that returns several related objects in one call; the open MCP tools have neither (`packages/mcp/src/mcp-http-tools.ts:2907-3124`).
- The hosted ask set has two question kinds for exactly this (`owner_latest`, `join`), 9 of 56 questions.

## Scope

- Reading first: what the engine can already do in one statement (a window or a semi-join) for "latest per group" and for a parent with its children, and through which existing query members.
- Then expose it on the open door as one bounded read, under the caller's row and field security, with the same row cap and `truncated` contract as `query_records`.
- No slower path for a driver that cannot: a stable refusal.

## Done when

- "Each X with its latest Y" is one call on `examples/app-crm`, pinned; the open ask cards carry both kinds (#35113).

## Relations

- Parent: #34659. Related: #33619 (multi-hop), #33626 (cross-object cap), #35113.
